edits.rationale: Storage for the tier-3 arm: nullable jsonb sibling columns beside pages.sections, aligned-or-absent semantics stated in COMMENT ON. Column-before-binary ordering, same as 638 and for the same reason (the loader SELECTs them). No backfill, no default: absent = today's behaviour. Deliberately NO check constraint and NO trigger: pages.sections has 19 candidate writer files as of 2026-09-02; a constraint would error them all, a nulling trigger would destroy operator data — misalignment is instead kept-but-inert at read time, visibly (WARN + detector).

The deciding seam. (a) Tier 2: read section_subjects/section_facts sibling keys from the SAME aspect page object the sections came from (same-object construction; validate_plan already emits these keys). (b) Tier 3: read the row's two columns in the same query as sections; when the served list came from page_sections_fallback (collected_data) rather than the row, attach only if the row's stored sections CONTENT-EQUALS the served list (a same-length different list must not pass). (c) Merge nil-insertion and final emission guards keyed on the length invariant len(arrays)==len(sections) instead of specSource=='site_plan_tables' — the length equality IS the invariant, the source label was its proxy; tier 4 leaves the arrays nil so the guard is never satisfiable there (comment states it must stay that way). (d) 5b sync: when the LOCK-008 merge changes a tier-3 list whose arrays were served this run, write the nil-padded arrays back in the same UPDATE, repairing stored alignment in the one place we control. (e) WARN when stored arrays exist but do not align (visible degrade).

Observe-only build-side detector: after the site-level triple filter, a component name appearing >=2 times with >=1 subjectless instance files ONE durable agent_error_log finding via the action's existing channel. Distinct code from the planner-side SUBJECT_MISSING_ON_REPEATED_COMPONENT because the remedy differs (replan vs 'this page's serving tier carries no subjects — bugs_open/443') and the 358 registry names writers precisely. NOT gated on any-subject-present: the planner gate is retro-spam protection, and the pages this exists for can never carry subjects; bound is 25 repeat-layout pages fleet-wide as of 2026-09-02, one row per rebuild of one of them at worst.

358 discipline: the new code enters the estate WITH a declared disposition, in the shipping commit. disposition human-evidence (no automated consumer yet; the expected reader is whoever works 443 backfill and the RFC_063 decision), writer named as plan_sections, note cross-references the planner-side sibling code and states the revisit condition.
